title: C# Exceptions
description: When executing C# code, different errors can occur: coding errors made by the programmer, errors due to wrong input, or other unforeseeable things.

challenges.title: Basic Try/Catch
challenges.exercise: Write a try/catch block. In try, print an out-of-bounds array element. In catch, print 'Error'.
challenges.solution: try { int[] n = {1}; Console.WriteLine(n[5]); } catch { Console.WriteLine("Error"); }

challenges.title: Division by Zero
challenges.exercise: Catch a DivideByZeroException specifically and print 'Cannot divide by zero'.
challenges.solution: try { int x = 0; int y = 5 / x; } catch (DivideByZeroException) { Console.WriteLine("Cannot divide by zero"); }

challenges.title: Finally Block
challenges.exercise: Add a finally block that prints 'Done' after a try/catch.

challenges.title: Throw Keyword
challenges.exercise: Create a method that throws an ArithmeticException if age < 18. (Set age=15). Catch and print 'Underage'.

challenges.title: Multiple Catch
challenges.exercise: Print 'Handled' to show you understand that multiple catch blocks can handle different exception types.
